title: Milt Hinton's graciousness about the credit
summary: Milt apologizes for omitting his name and Williams brushes it off.

blocks.x: And the Judge says, “Jackie I got to apologize,” he says, “I didn’t see your name on that thing so I don’t want you to think it was—” I says, “Well Judge, don’t worry about it, I’m © Fillius Jazz Archive -12-

on there.” So he was trying to — I says, “it’s not necessary — it’s your date, that’s the most important thing.” Now everybody else is around you, you know. But he’s just like that you know. He wants to make everybody happy all the time.
